name: Monitor Lizard

review.observation: Full original: narrow monitor head, clearly forked protruding tongue, banded long continuous tail, spotted/banded scales and four distinct clawed feet. Body is lightly raised in a reptile stride; far proximal limbs partly overlap the torso. Natural tail is visibly long, but exact longer-than-body ratio and claw counts remain for anatomical review. Broad magenta margins.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. Any ear opening, tympanum, protective ear flap, casque, horn, neck frill or external gill remains natural head/neck paint; none is a substitute pinna.

policyStatus: AUDIT_ONLY_CANDIDATE: production reviewed-presence.mjs still admits tail absence only.
